title: The "Quick Nap" Gamble
hook: That dangerous moment you decide to take a "20-minute power nap."
script:
(Visual: Realistic AI scene. A person collapses onto a bed in broad daylight, wearing a hoodie. They set a phone alarm for 20 minutes with a confident smirk.)

(Action: Cut to the person waking up in total darkness. They look panicked. They check the phone.)

(Dialogue - Voiceover, whispered and horrified): "Wait... is it 6:00 PM or 6:00 AM?"

(Action: They sit up slowly. A single, distant bird chirps. They check the date on the phone. Their eyes widen.)

(Dialogue - Voiceover): "I've slept through an entire fiscal quarter."

(Visual: Cut to a shot of the person staring blankly at the wall while the "Windows Shutdown" sound plays.)
caption: I didn’t wake up, I respawned in a different timeline. 🚩 #LifeIsAGlitch #Adulting #PowerNap #ExistentialDread
